scenes.text: Here's how to add 404 Missing to your website. Start with Node twenty-two or later, then install the release linked in the README. For United States appeals, request your own NCMEC access using the API access guide.

Next, add the missing children API route to your server. Copy the configuration from the README. Keep your provider credentials in server-only environment variables, and use a private token store. Never put those keys in your page or browser bundle.

Now open the guide for your framework. React and Vue have adapters. Astro, Ember, and plain HTML use the web component. Add it to your existing 404 page, point it at your API route, and choose a country. Keep your home link visible.

Finally, visit a URL that doesn't exist. Check that it still returns HTTP 404 and that the official appeal or directory link works. The UK currently uses an official directory link while partner feed access is arranged. Copy the exact steps from the README, and you're ready to start.
